mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{beginTime} AND pay_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{beginTime} AND pay_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{beginTime} AND pay_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `user` WHERE create_time >= #{beginTime} AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{beginTime} AND order_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{beginTime} AND order_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{beginTime} AND order_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT d.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS `number`, SUM(d.amount) AS amount FROM order_detail d INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = d.order_id WHERE o.status = 5 AND o.pay_status = 1 AND (d.service_item_id IS NOT NULL OR d.service_package_id IS NOT NULL) AND o.order_time >= #{beginTime} AND o.order_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY CASE WHEN d.service_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('item-', d.service_item_id) ELSE CONCAT('package-', d.service_package_id) END, d.name ORDER BY `number` DESC, amount DESC LIMIT 10
